entries.title: Don't Starve
entries.definitive_edition: Don't Starve on Windows PC with Reign of Giants, Shipwrecked, and Hamlet

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Steam PC release with Reign of Giants, Shipwrecked, and Hamlet
primary.why: The Windows PC version is the original release, has the highest capture/settings flexibility, Steam Workshop support, and the complete single-player DLC path. Console, Switch, and mobile editions are useful access routes, but they do not add sourced exclusive gameplay content over the complete PC route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Don't Starve on Windows PC through Steam and install the Reign of Giants, Shipwrecked, and Hamlet DLC for the full single-player content set.

entries.remaster_caveats: Giant Edition, Pocket Edition, Nintendo Switch Edition, and Mega Pack are ports/bundles, not separate base-game sequels. Don't Starve Together is a separate standalone multiplayer entry and is listed separately.

entries.title: Don't Starve Together
entries.definitive_edition: Don't Starve Together on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with the strongest server/mod route.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the original full-release route, has the strongest update/mod/server ecosystem, and is the best capture/settings platform. Console, Switch, PS5, and announced mobile ports are valid access routes, but no sourced gameplay content exceeds the PC route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC version on Steam for the strongest multiplayer, update, and capture route. Use console or Switch only if that is where the group is playing; mobile releases are announced for July 21, 2026.

entries.remaster_caveats: Console Edition, PS5, Switch, and mobile versions are ports/access routes. Character/item packs and chest bundles are DLC/cosmetic or account-content purchases rather than separate game entries.
